Title: Generally Available: Azure Database for PostgreSQL storage extension support for Parquet

Body.Content:
Announcing that Azure Database for PostgreSQL flexible server now supports the Azure Storage extension with Parquet format and multiple compression options. You can seamlessly read and write Parquet files directly from your database, enabling faster data exchange with analytics and storage systems while reducing storage costs through efficient compression. With this capability, you can simplify your data pipelines, improve performance for large-scale workloads, and optimize your cloud storage usage—all without leaving your PostgreSQL environment. 

Learn more.
